finish: Original Blender-authored educational anatomical study. Not a scan, mocap, photorealism or expert-validated biomechanics.

authorship.geometry: Original custom anatomical lofts voxel-unified into the torso and limbs; continuous signed-distance craniofacial sculpt with shallow orbital recesses, flat nose, connected muzzle and lips. No third-party animal mesh.
authorship.materials: Original russet directional texture and painted craniofacial coat/skin atlas; packed in editable source.
authorship.groom: Area-random draped mesh cards with varying length and strand shades; anatomical weights inherited from final continuous body.
authorship.rig: 38-bone original skeletal rig. Continuous masked distance weights, normalized maximum4 influences.

visual_review.status: Passed authored educational visual review; optimized Three.js consumer review belongs to integration audit.
findings: Unflanged female head; no mature cheek pads. Bare gray-brown facial skin, small inset dark eyes and continuous muzzle.
Long arms, short bowed legs, curved long fingers and opposed grasping toes are readable.
Irregular russet coat and head silhouette read as coarse hair; mobile groom intentionally reduced.
No detached hands, floating facial masks, crossed limbs, shoulder spikes or visible floor penetration in reviewed samples.
weaknesses: Hand-authored educational motion is simplified; Walk is a slow lowered fist-supported in-place illustration.
Climb is an alternating in-place canopy-grasp illustration without a modeled branch or traversal path.
Sparse mobile fur has a smoother silhouette than the desktop groom.

grounding.origin: Grounded at bare feet, floor Z=0. Low calf strand tips constrained.

scope: Only orangutan assets, generator/rig/LOD/review scripts and orangutan reports modified. No app, registry, publishing or other species changes.
